description: worker_output: what one prereview worker returns.

schema_revision.description: Current revision; any in-window patch bumps it here and in every fixture, so stale fixtures fail explicitly.

records.description: Candidate and coverage records only; one coverage record per changed unit.

category.description: C1 written guarantee exceeds evidence, C2 real production defect, C3 weak evidence, C4 base or process drift, C5 scope or placement, C7 other.

unit_id.description: A unit_id from units.json: path, hash sign, first 12 hex of the sha256 of the normalised hunk body, or path#file for binary or over-size files.

local_id.description: Worker-local identifier, unique within this envelope; RECORDS mints the C-n id.

anchor.description: hunk = inside a changed hunk, file = elsewhere in a changed file, absent = anywhere else in the snapshot tree.

file.description: A path of the snapshot tree (forward slashes, repository-relative).

symbol.description: Function, class or heading; null only when line_start is an integer.

unit_ids.description: May be empty; membership in units.json is checked by RECORDS.

trigger.description: What in the diff or tree raised the finding.

contract_ref.description: lesson:L{n} | rubric:{n} | acceptance:A{n} or R{n} | frozen:{path} | none

evidence_refs.description: Locations already read that support the finding (path:line or unit_id).

evidence_needed.description: What would settle the finding but was not available in the pack.

status.description: missing is state-only (synthesised by RECORDS) and is not a worker value.

candidate_local_ids.description: local_id values of the candidates raised on this unit.

missing_context.description: Non-empty when status is blocked: the locations the worker needed and could not read.
